description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEnforcerActor' which extends a generic actor class 'AbstractGraphActor'. It provides infrastructure for enforcement behaviors within a larger system that uses Akka actors. The class manages caches, handles invalidation, creates timers for metrics, and sets up pub/sub mechanisms for coordination among nodes. It is part of a package related to enforcement services in the Eclipse Ditto project.
